concepts.name: forcing_capture_must_not_drop_the_attacker
concepts.trigger: a capture or forcing move lands a piece on a square with immediate low-cost recapture and no compensating gain
concepts.value_adjustment: penalize these forcing moves; reward alternatives that keep the attacker defended or improve recapture balance first
concepts.why: multiple forcing captures immediately lost the moved piece and reversed value

concepts.name: high_value_piece_trade_square_safety
concepts.trigger: queen or rook captures onto a contested square where an equal or lower-cost immediate recapture is available
concepts.value_adjustment: strongly penalize entering contested capture squares with high-value pieces unless follow-up secures net gain
concepts.why: queen/rook activity choices repeatedly allowed immediate recapture with large value loss

concepts.name: checking_move_requires_checker_survival
concepts.trigger: a checking move leaves the checking piece capturable by the king on the next move
concepts.value_adjustment: strongly penalize such checks unless the king capture is illegal or loses decisive material immediately
concepts.why: repeated king-capturable checks lost the checking piece, including queen losses

concepts.name: king_capture_opportunism_in_simplified_positions
concepts.trigger: in reduced-material positions, the king has a legal safe capture that removes an active enemy unit
concepts.value_adjustment: increase priority for safe king captures; penalize king moves that ignore immediate safe capture gains
concepts.why: safe king-capture opportunities were skipped, reducing conversion efficiency

concepts.name: low_clock_conversion_mode
concepts.trigger: long game with advantage where clock risk grows and tactical precision demands are high
concepts.value_adjustment: shift value toward faster, simpler, low-blunder moves (safe exchanges, direct promotion support, immediate threat neutralization); penalize slow speculative maneuvering
concepts.why: a large advantage and near-promotion position still ended in a time loss and failed conversion
